summary: Full e2e testing for Manajemen Izin & Kegiatan Pegawai (Indonesian). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (auth, employees, activities, leaves, activity-logs, pending, reports/absences, reports/activities). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844 mobile viewport): login role gate works, admin PIN 1234 login OK, wrong pin rejected, employee list picker functional. Employee submitted izin (sakit) and kegiatan luar via forms — both landed as pending. Admin persetujuan tab lists pending items with approve/reject buttons; approving both cleared the queue and updated report counts. Laporan segmented (Tidak Hadir days / Kegiatan Luar count) renders per employee with correct counts. Kelola tab (Pegawai/Kegiatan) add/delete works. Admin-recorded izin form has employee picker chip row; not shown for employees. No React Native red screen, no deprecated packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch used). All text wrapped in <Text>. Design tidy (sage green minimal), 8pt spacing, touch targets >=40px.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider lifespan context manager (non-blocking, not required for MVP).
backend/.env contains ADMIN_PIN in plain text; acceptable for MVP role gate but note in docs.
No date validation on leaves (end_date < start_date is not rejected); _days_between returns min 1 so counts remain sane, but consider server-side validation.
MongoDB ObjectId correctly excluded via NO_ID projection everywhere — good.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 4 employees (Andi Saputra, Siti Rahayu, Budi Santoso, Dewi Lestari) and 4 activities on startup if empty. All TEST_ data created during testing was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin PIN=1234. Employee login = just pick from seeded list (no password). Employee-created izin/kegiatan default to pending; admin-created default to approved. Reports only count approved. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Fresh MVP works end-to-end.
